description: A FastAPI app that sends notifications through Courier from background tasks, including email and inbox notifications when an AI agent run finishes.
rules: Use the trycourier package from PyPI and import it as from courier import AsyncCourier in async routes.
Read COURIER_API_KEY from the environment and keep it server-side.
Queue Courier sends with FastAPI BackgroundTasks so the response returns without waiting on Courier.
Pass one idempotency key per event to client.send.message: welcome-<user_id> per saved user, agent-run-<run_id>-finished per agent run.
Notify a finished agent run by email and inbox with routing {"method": "all", "channels": ["email", "inbox"]}.
